data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'asiya', meaning helper or supporter. In Islamic culture, the name Asiyeh is associated with providing aid, support, and comfort. The name Asiyeh carries the meaning “Helpful, Supportive” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Asiyeh usually hope their child will grow to embody helpful, supportive and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asiyeh total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
